import site, sys, glob, os

# Candidate user site-packages locations
candidates = []
for p in [site.getusersitepackages(), "/tmp/.local/lib"]:
    candidates.append(p)

# Also search common python version dirs under /tmp/.local/lib
candidates += glob.glob("/tmp/.local/lib/python*/site-packages")
candidates += glob.glob(os.path.expanduser("~/.local/lib/python*/site-packages"))

print("Current sys.path:")
for p in sys.path:
    print("  ", p)

print("\nCandidates found:")
for c in candidates:
    if os.path.isdir(c):
        print("  EXISTS:", c, "->", os.listdir(c)[:10])
    else:
        print("  missing:", c)
